 Coram:

 Order

The instant application under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal, 1973 has been filed on behalf of petitioner seeking grant of regular bail in FIR bearing No. 69/2020,
registered at Police Station EOW, Delhi for the offences punishable under Sections 420/406/467/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Mr. Manoj Pant, learned APP accepts notice on behalf of State and seeks time to file Status Report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing and advance copy of Status Report be supplied to learned counsel for the petitioner.
The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
